description_en: Creates a container firewall blocking rule
kebab_example: aliyun sas create-interception-rule --cluster-id c35xxxa416 --rule-name test-rule-1 --rule-switch 0 --cluster-name sas-test-cnnf --order-index 1 --intercept-type 1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateInterceptionRule

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the container cluster to query.
You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

This parameter must be from an ACK cluster. You can call the DescribeClustersV1 operation of Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) to query existing clusters, or call the CreateCluster operation to create a cluster, and then call the DescribeGroupedContainerInstances operation of Security Center to obtain the ID of a managed cluster
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的容器集群的ID。
您可以调用[DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~)接口获取该参数。

本参数必须来自 ACK 容器服务集群。可通过容器服务 CS 的 DescribeClustersV1 查询已有集群，或通过 CreateCluster 创建集群，再调用云安全中心 DescribeGroupedContainerInstances 获取已纳管的集群 ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
指定启用规则的开关状态。取值：
0：关闭
1：开启
parameters.name: rule_switch

parameters.help_en:
The source object. The metric description is as follows:

targetId: The ID of the source object. You can invoke the [ListInterceptionTargetPage](~~ListInterceptionTargetPage~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
源对象。包含的参数说明如下：

targetId：源对象ID，您可以调用[ListInterceptionTargetPage](~~ListInterceptionTargetPage~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: src_target

parameters.help_en:
The list of destination objects. The metric descriptions are as follows:

targetId: The ID of the destination object. You can invoke the [ListInterceptionTargetPage](~~ListInterceptionTargetPage~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
ports: The list of destination port ranges
parameters.help_zh:
目的对象列表。包含的参数说明如下：

targetId：目的对象ID，您可以调用[ListInterceptionTargetPage](~~ListInterceptionTargetPage~~)接口获取该参数。
ports：目标端口范围列表
parameters.name: dst_target_list

parameters.help_en:
The type of the rule. Valid values:
customize: user-defined rule
parameters.help_zh:
规则类型。取值：
customize：用户规则
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en: The priority of the rule. Valid values: 1 to 1000. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则优先级，取值为1~1000，数字越小优先级越高
parameters.name: order_index

parameters.help_en:
The interception mode. Valid values:
1: Block Mode.
2: Alert mode.
3: Allow mode
parameters.help_zh:
拦截模式。取值：
1：拦截模式
2：告警模式
3：放行模式
parameters.name: intercept_type

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
